state:
Goal `core-router-and-4-more`, stage 2 (feature proofs). `Core\Router` and `Core\Router\Match` are done. `Core\Script` and `Core\Script\ExitReport` now have class cards and are gone from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. Every card in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/script.rs` is rewritten in plain words, including `Core\Script\ExitReason`'s.

`Core\Script`'s three members have every proof on disk: about, three examples each under `docs/examples/core/Script/`, an attack each under `tests/hostile/core/Script/`, benches for `args` and `onExit`, and a `data/proofs/policy.json` perf skip for `finish` (a script ends once). The Rust `covers:` tests are in `script.rs`'s test module; `args_answers_the_isolates_own_value_as_a_second_reference` is new.

The attacks found two bugs, both fixed and pinned. An arrow function whose body is a `void` call failed to compile (`crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/closure.rs`, pinned by `tests/conformance/closures/an-expression-body-that-is-a-void-call-returns-nothing.nvst`). A `spawn script` whose argument was refused released it twice and panicked at teardown (`crates/nvs-host/src/group.rs`'s `own` and `given_up_once_started`, and the graph walk now releases a refused object; pinned by `tests/conformance/core/a-spawn-that-refuses-its-argument-leaves-the-parents-value-whole.nvst`).

`exit` and `Core\Script::finish()` inside an exit function stop that function and log a `RuntimeError`, and no `catch` in the function sees it. The `onExit` card says so.

`Core\Script\ExitReport`'s members and `Core\Secret` are not started.

items.text: **`Core\Script\ExitReport`'s members** — `reason`, `status`, `error` each owe about, three examples, an attack, a bench and two Novis test cases with a `covers:` marker (instance members are not credited by a call). Existing cases to mark: `tests/conformance/core/script-exit-report-members-agree-and-one-queue-sees-one-report.nvst`, `tests/conformance/core/script-on-exit-carries-the-live-throwable-of-an-uncaught-throw.nvst`, `tests/conformance/core/script-exit-report-carries-the-status-the-exit-named-with-no-error-beside-it.nvst`. The accessors are at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/script.rs:302` (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). A report exists only inside an exit function, so a bench registers one function that loops over the report's accessor.

**`Core\Secret`'s class card and members** — `reveal`, `revealBytes`, a `ClassDoc` above the `CLASS` row, deleted from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5342` (`rule:core-api/reference-card`, `rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/secret.rs:1`

backlog: The graph walk never adopts a child node, because a parent retains each child before descending, so only the root can be moved at refcount 1. The spawn seam now retains the root too. `crates/nvs-runtime/src/graph.rs`'s module doc, *a move at refcount 1*, reads as if every node can be moved.

`Isolate::start`'s `max_script_depth` refusal returns `Ok` without consuming its argument, and `crates/nvs-host/src/group.rs`'s `given_up_once_started` balances that only because the stdlib helper then answers `Fault::Pending`. `crates/nvs-host/src/isolate.rs:583`.
